description: This file defines the interface for a map editor class used in the Wesnoth game, including methods for handling events, map modifications, undo/redo, and UI interactions.

classes.name: map_editor
classes.description: A class representing a map editor that handles SDL events, map modifications, undo/redo, and user interface interactions within the Wesnoth game.

methods.name: main_loop
methods.description: Runs the main event loop of the map editor until an abort condition is set.

methods.name: set_file_to_save_as
methods.description: Sets the filename for saving the current map.

methods.name: save_map
methods.description: Saves the current map to a file, optionally showing a confirmation message.

methods.name: load_map
methods.description: Loads a map from a specified filename, returning its string representation or throwing an exception on failure.

methods.name: handle_event
methods.description: Handles an SDL event.

methods.name: handle_keyboard_event
methods.description: Processes keyboard events with current mouse position.

methods.name: handle_mouse_button_event
methods.description: Processes mouse button events with current mouse position.

methods.name: changed_since_save
methods.description: Checks if the map has been modified since the last save.

methods.name: redraw_everything
methods.description: Recalculates layout and redraws the entire editor UI.

methods.name: change_language
methods.description: Changes the in-game language.

methods.name: toggle_grid
methods.description: Toggles the grid overlay in the editor.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Undoes the last action.

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Redoes the last undone action.

methods.name: preferences
methods.description: Opens the preferences dialog.

methods.name: edit_quit
methods.description: Exits the editor, prompting to save if needed.

methods.name: edit_new_map
methods.description: Creates a new map.

methods.name: edit_load_map
methods.description: Loads a map from file.

methods.name: edit_save_map
methods.description: Saves the current map.

methods.name: edit_save_as
methods.description: Saves the current map under a new filename.

methods.name: edit_set_start_pos
methods.description: Sets the starting position for a player.

methods.name: edit_flood_fill
methods.description: Performs a flood fill operation on the map.

methods.name: edit_fill_selection
methods.description: Fills the selected area.

methods.name: edit_cut
methods.description: Cuts the selected area.

methods.name: edit_copy
methods.description: Copies the selected area.

methods.name: edit_paste
methods.description: Pastes the clipboard contents.

methods.name: edit_revert
methods.description: Reverts changes.

methods.name: edit_resize
methods.description: Resizes the map.

methods.name: edit_flip
methods.description: Flips the map or selection.

methods.name: edit_select_all
methods.description: Selects all hexes on the map.

methods.name: edit_draw
methods.description: Enables terrain drawing mode.

methods.name: edit_refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the editor display.

methods.name: perform_flood_fill
methods.description: Executes flood fill operation.

methods.name: perform_paste
methods.description: Executes paste operation.

methods.name: perform_set_starting_pos
methods.description: Sets starting position for a player.

methods.name: can_execute_command
methods.description: Checks if a hotkey command can be executed.

methods.name: confirm_exit_and_save
methods.description: Confirms exit and saves the map if needed.

methods.name: set_starting_position
methods.description: Sets a player's starting position.

methods.name: verify_filename
methods.description: Checks for illegal characters in filename.

methods.name: show_menu
methods.description: Displays a menu at specified location.

methods.name: execute_command
methods.description: Executes a hotkey command.

methods.name: draw_terrain
methods.description: Draws terrain at a specific location.

methods.name: invalidate_adjacent
methods.description: Invalidates terrain at a location and its neighbors.

methods.name: invalidate_all_and_adjacent
methods.description: Invalidates terrain for a set of locations and their neighbors.

methods.name: recalculate_starting_pos_labels
methods.description: Recalculates labels for starting positions.

methods.name: update_mouse_over_hexes
methods.description: Updates highlighted hexes under the mouse.

methods.name: insert_selection_in_clipboard
methods.description: Copies selected hexes to clipboard.

methods.name: get_hex_with_offset
methods.description: Calculates a hex location with an offset.

methods.name: perform_selection_move
methods.description: Completes a move of selected hexes.

methods.name: highlight_selected_hexes
methods.description: Highlights selected hexes in the UI.

methods.name: clear_highlighted_hexes_in_gui
methods.description: Clears highlighted hexes.

methods.name: terrain_changed
methods.description: Handles terrain change at a location or set of locations.

methods.name: save_undo_action
methods.description: Records an undoable action.

methods.name: left_button_func_changed
methods.description: Updates UI when left mouse button function changes.

methods.name: update_l_button_palette
methods.description: Updates UI palette for left button functions.

methods.name: get_action_name
methods.description: Returns string name for a left button function.

methods.name: is_left_button_func_menu
methods.description: Checks if a menu is for setting left button function.

methods.name: draw_on_mouseover_hexes
methods.description: Draws terrain on hexes under mouse cursor.

methods.name: load_tooltips
methods.description: Loads tooltip data for UI buttons.
